patch.description:
Updates the specified draft version of an agent. `version_number` is required.

**Managing functions via this endpoint:**
- Pass `agent_functions: [...]` to replace the version's functions. The platform `end_call` function is always kept.
- Pass `agent_functions: []` to remove every function except `end_call`.
- Omit `agent_functions` entirely to leave existing functions untouched.

**Post-call analysis LLM:**
- Pass `post_call_analysis_llm_id`, for example `llm_A1B2C3D4E5F6G7`, to set the LLM used for post-call field extraction.
- Pass `null` to clear it so the workspace default is used.
- Omit the field to leave it unchanged.
- It is stored on the version's existing post-call fields: it has no effect when there are none, a replaced `post_call_analysis` list gets new fields without it, and it is saved before the rest of the request is validated, so a rejected request can still have changed it.

**Phone numbers** are linked to the agent, not to a version. Manage them with `/v1/agents/{agentId}/phone-numbers`. Every version uses the agent's numbers, and inbound calls run on the latest published version.

**While a batch is running on this agent**, the request returns `409 Conflict` with code `AGENT_HAS_RUNNING_BATCH` when it would change a published version in place (runtime fields; `version_title` and `folder_id` can still change) or change `timezone` or `pipeline_type`. Drafts stay editable and can be published. The running batch keeps dialing the version it was created with.

A published version cannot be edited. Runtime changes are blocked while a batch runs on the agent; edit and publish a new draft instead.

Null is ignored for `end_call_on_hold_sec`, `language_default_message`, `version_title`, `reminder_message_content`, `llm_fallback_model` and `llm_fallback_delay_ms`: the stored value is kept.

post.description: Uploads a CSV or Excel file and creates a batch pinned to a published agent version and an outbound number. The response status initiated means accepted; the saved job is waiting or scheduled. Multiple batches can run concurrently within available workspace capacity. A request that fails, for example on row validation, KYC or an unsupported file type, leaves no batch behind.

file.description: CSV, XLSX or XLS file containing leads (max 10 MB). Needs a phone number column; every number must include its country code.

agent_version_number.description: Must be a published version. Omit to use the agent's latest published version. The batch stays on this version even if the agent is published again.

phone_number_id.description: One of the agent's outbound numbers to dial from. Required when the agent has more than one outbound number.

starts_at.description: ISO 8601 datetime: leave empty to start immediately

ends_at.description: ISO 8601 datetime stored with the batch. The scheduler does not enforce it today: calls are not stopped at this time.

calling_hours_start.description: Time of day (for example `09:00`) stored with the batch. The scheduler does not enforce it today. The API does not validate it; a value that is not a valid time returns 500.

calling_hours_end.description: Time of day (for example `18:00`) stored with the batch. The scheduler does not enforce it today. The API does not validate it; a value that is not a valid time returns 500.

number_of_retries.description: How many times to retry a lead that did not connect, from 0 to 4. Omit both retry fields for no retries. Must be 0 when interval_between_retries is 0, and greater than 0 when it is not; send both fields together.

interval_between_retries.description: Minutes to wait between retries, from 0 to 1440. Must be 0 when number_of_retries is 0, and greater than 0 when it is not. Send it whenever number_of_retries is above 0: without it the retry is scheduled with no wait.

201.description: Batch accepted. status is initiated; from_number identifies the selected outbound number. No scheduling-conflict warning is returned.

primary_goal.description: Primary outcome the agent should achieve on each call
primary_goal.example: Book demos and answer pricing and onboarding questions.

structured_input.description: Structured blueprint submission: each field has a description (field guidance) and value (user answer)

build_attempt.description: Build attempt number (1 to 2). Validation runs only on attempt 1; attempt 2 skips re-validation.

pipeline.description: Engine for the generated agent. "s2s" builds the realtime pipeline on the same single-prompt agent; anything else builds the cascaded pipeline.

target_shape.description: Kind of agent to build. "cfa" writes a conversation-flow document (a step graph), "ivr" writes a touch-tone menu; anything else builds a single-prompt agent.

company_and_offering.example: A motor insurance provider handling accident claims.

primary_goal.example: Take first notice of loss and log the claim.

success_criteria.example: All the claim details are captured and logged.

information_to_collect.example: Full name, date of birth, policy number

objections_and_faqs.example: Why is my premium going up, how long does a claim take

additional_context.example: Never quote a settlement amount on the call.

language.description: Language name as shown in the picker

field_name.description: Unique within the version. Must not be blank.

additional_fields.description: Choices for SELECTOR (required, at least one) or example values for TEXT. Normally an array of strings.

display_order.description: Position in the list; defaults to the array index.

description.example: Books a calendar appointment for the caller

current_version_number.description: Number of the current version. Serialized as a string (the column is a 64-bit integer).

version_number.description: Version number. Serialized as a string (the column is a 64-bit integer).

language.description: Associated resource when configured. Included record; its own IDs are unprefixed.

llm.description: Associated resource when configured. Included record; its own IDs are unprefixed.

end_call_on_hold_sec.description: Seconds to wait in a confirmed hold before hanging up; null when disabled.

language_default_message.description: Message spoken when the caller language is not supported.

prompt_tokens.description: Token count of the stored prompt, when computed.

secondary_language_ids.description: Additional language IDs the version can switch to.

speech_to_speech_english_accent.description: Accent of the agent's English on Speech-to-Speech calls: indian (default), british or american.

postcall_analysis.description: Post-call fields of this version. llm_id is the extraction LLM (null for the workspace default).

agent_functions.description: Functions of this version. Returned by Get Agent, create and update; not by List Agents. agent_id is unprefixed.

updatedAt.description: When the agent record was last changed.

is_deleted.description: Whether the agent has been deleted. The list endpoint returns only agents where this is false.

AgentRecord.description: An agent as stored. Returned by the list and get endpoints.

PhoneNumberRecord.description: A phone number owned by the workspace, as stored. Returned by the list and get endpoints.

phone_number.description: National number without the country calling code or a plus sign, as a string of digits. Build the E.164 form as + followed by country_iso and phone_number.

country_iso.description: Country calling code without the plus sign, for example 91 or 1. This is not an ISO country code.

telephony_provider_id.description: Telephony provider the number belongs to.

inbound_agent_id.description: Agent that answers inbound calls on this number, on its latest published version; null when none is linked.

outbound_agent_id.description: Agent that can call from this number; null when none is linked.

sip_trunk_enabled.description: Whether a SIP trunk is linked to this number.

CodedErrorResponse.description: Error body for a coded refusal; data carries code and its details.

data.description: For a coded refusal, an object with code and the details listed for that code. Otherwise an empty array.

errors.description: Validation messages for a 400. Empty for other errors.

validation_errors.description: Present when uploaded rows fail number validation (batch and workflow lead uploads): one group per distinct error.

invalid_row_count.description: Present with validation_errors: how many rows failed.

move.description: Move the number here when another agent holds it in this direction. That agent loses it in the same request, under the same rules as detaching it there.

phone_number_id.description: One of the batch's agent's outbound numbers to dial from.
